settings.label: Brim ears on the outside only

effect.increase: A wider brim holds the part better and costs more time
effect.decrease: A narrower brim frees more bed space

effect.increase: More skirt loops prime the nozzle longer
effect.decrease: No skirt skips priming

settings.label: Smooth outer walls only
settings.help: Applies extrusion rate smoothing only to outer walls and overhangs, where speed changes show, and leaves the rest of the print at full speed.

settings.label: Extrusion rate smoothing
settings.help: Limits how fast the volumetric flow may change, in mm3/s per second, so sudden speed changes leave no bulges or gaps. 0 turns it off. Fast printers with pressure advance rarely need it (try 300); slow printers without it start at 10 to 15 for direct drive and 5 to 10 for Bowden. Turns arc fitting off.

settings.label: Smoothing segment length
settings.help: Length of the steps a smoothed line is cut into, in mm. Shorter steps change the flow more smoothly but make the G-code larger. Raise it if the printer stutters.

settings.label: Painted color interlocking depth
settings.help: On every other layer, painted colors reach this deep instead, in mm, so the two filaments interlock and hold together better. 0 turns it off. Not used with beam interlocking.

settings.label: Painted color depth
settings.help: How far painted colors reach in from the outside of the part, in mm. The inside prints in the part's own filament, which saves filament. 0 lets the color fill the whole painted region.

settings.label: Small area flow compensation
settings.help: Lowers the flow of short solid infill lines, which tend to over-extrude in small areas. The small area flow model sets how much.

settings.label: Small area flow model
settings.help: Pairs of line length in mm and flow factor, one pair per line, shortest first. A line takes the factor for its length, smoothly between the points, and full flow past the last length.

settings.label: Filename format
settings.help: The name of the exported G-code file. Placeholders in braces fill in when slicing ends, such as {input_filename_base}, {plate_name}, {plate_number}, {print_time}, {total_weight}, {timestamp} and any setting (for example {filament_type[initial_tool]}). Characters a file name cannot hold become _.

settings.label: Add line numbers
settings.help: Puts N1, N2 and so on in front of every G-code command, for printers and hosts that check line numbers. Comments are not numbered, and binary G-code gets none.

settings.label: Notes
settings.help: Your own notes about this process profile. They are written as comments at the top of the G-code.

settings.label: G-code on feature change
settings.help: G-code written each time the print moves to another feature, such as outer wall, sparse infill or support, after the printer's and the filament's own. It can read extrusion_role, last_extrusion_role, layer_num and layer_z.

effect.increase: Higher acceleration saves time and increases ringing
effect.decrease: Lower acceleration is quieter and cleaner

effect.increase: A prime tower cleans the nozzle between colors and uses more filament
effect.decrease: Without a prime tower colors may bleed

settings.label: Enable tower interface cooldown during tower
Place prime tower automatically
settings.help: Puts the prime tower on a free spot next to the objects, clear of the printer's no-go areas, and widens it when nothing else fits. Turn off to keep the tower where you put it.

settings.label: Bridge counterbore holes
settings.help: Bridges the step of a counterbore hole so it prints without supports. Partially bridge covers only part of the opening; sacrificial layer prints a full bridge layer you drill or cut out after printing.

settings.label: Filter small internal bridges
settings.help: Which small internal bridges are dropped so solid infill prints straight over the sparse infill. Filter suits most parts; limited and no filtering add bridges under slanted and curved tops, which reduces pillowing at some cost in time.

effect.increase: The first layer is pulled in more to counter elephant foot
effect.decrease: The first layer flares out more

settings.label: Extra bridge layers
settings.help: Prints a second bridge layer over bridges, so the solid layers above sag less and top surfaces show less pillowing. External bridges get a second layer in the same direction, internal bridges one at a right angle.

settings.label: Line width on the first layer

effect.increase: A thicker first layer hides bed unevenness but is harder to squish flat
effect.decrease: A thinner first layer needs a level bed

effect.increase: Ironing smooths chosen top surfaces and adds time
effect.decrease: Without ironing top surfaces print faster and rougher

effect.increase: Thicker layers print faster and show more layer lines
effect.decrease: Thinner layers print slower and look smoother

effect.increase: Wider lines print faster and bond better
effect.decrease: Narrower lines resolve finer detail

settings.label: Single wall on the top surface

effect.increase: Changes where layer starts and ends are placed
effect.decrease: Changes where layer starts and ends are placed

settings.label: sleipnir
settings.help: Automatic variable layer height. Off keeps one layer height. Quality thins layers where curved and detailed surfaces need it; Strength thins layers where the part carries load and keeps them thick elsewhere.

effect.increase: sleipnir changes layer heights along the part
effect.decrease: One layer height throughout

settings.label: sleipnir thickest layer
settings.help: The thickest layer sleipnir may use. Keep it at most three quarters of the nozzle diameter unless the material's research says otherwise.

effect.increase: Plain areas print faster and look coarser
effect.decrease: Plain areas print slower and look smoother

settings.label: sleipnir largest step
settings.help: The biggest change in layer height from one layer to the next, as a fraction of the previous layer. Smaller steps look smoother.

effect.increase: Layer height may jump more between layers
effect.decrease: Layer height changes in smaller steps

settings.label: sleipnir thinnest layer
settings.help: The thinnest layer sleipnir may use. Keep it at least a quarter of the nozzle diameter unless the material's research says otherwise.

effect.increase: Fine areas get thicker layers and less detail
effect.decrease: Fine areas get thinner layers and print slower

settings.label: sleipnir smoothing
settings.help: How strongly neighboring layer heights are blended. 0 follows the surface exactly, 100 gives the gentlest change.

effect.increase: Layer height changes more gradually
effect.decrease: Layer height follows the surface more closely

settings.label: sleipnir smoothing distance
settings.help: How far, along the height of the part, layer heights are blended. 0 picks eight times the thickest layer.

effect.increase: Layer height changes over a longer stretch
effect.decrease: Layer height changes over a shorter stretch

effect.increase: Outer contours print larger
effect.decrease: Outer contours print smaller

effect.increase: Holes print larger
effect.decrease: Holes print smaller

effect.increase: Travel detours around walls to cut stringing and adds time
effect.decrease: Travel goes straight and can string

settings.label: Special top infill order for flow tests
Enable wrapping detection
settings.help: Runs the wrapping detection G-code on every layer, on printers that can detect filament wrapping around the nozzle.

effect.increase: Fuzzy skin roughens the outer wall for grip and hides layer lines
effect.decrease: Smooth outer walls

settings.label: Fuzzy skin layers between ripple offset
Flow ratio at the end of a vase

effect.increase: Vase mode prints one continuous outer wall with no infill
effect.decrease: Normal layered printing

settings.label: Flow ratio at the start of a vase
Infill speed on the first layer

effect.increase: A faster first layer saves time and risks poor adhesion
effect.decrease: A slower first layer sticks better

effect.increase: Faster inner walls save time
effect.decrease: Slower inner walls improve bonding

effect.increase: A faster outer wall saves time and can show ringing
effect.decrease: A slower outer wall gives a cleaner surface

effect.increase: Faster infill saves time, limited by the hotend flow
effect.decrease: Slower infill costs time and helps little

effect.increase: Faster top surfaces save time and roughen the finish
effect.decrease: Slower top surfaces look smoother

effect.increase: Faster travel saves time and can cause vibration
effect.decrease: Slower travel is quieter

settings.label: Turn infill with the model
settings.help: Turns the infill and the fixed bridge angles with the model when you rotate it on the plate, so the lines keep the same direction on the part.

effect.increase: Thicker bottom skin adds strength and time
effect.decrease: Thinner bottom skin saves time

settings.label: Bottom surface density
settings.help: How densely the bottom surface is filled, in percent. 100 % gives a solid bottom; lower values space the lines out and save filament.

settings.label: Keep shells thick on steep sides
Extra solid infill layers
settings.help: Layers whose sparse infill prints solid, to stiffen tall parts. List layer numbers like 1,7,9. 5 makes every fifth layer solid, and 5#2 makes two layers solid every fifth layer. Leave empty for none.

settings.label: Stronger gyroid along Z
settings.help: Shortens the gyroid's waves along the height at low densities (below about 30 %), so the infill resists crushing from above better at about the same filament.

settings.label: Combine infill layers
settings.help: Prints the sparse infill once every few layers, as one thicker layer, to save time. Layers combine up to the nozzle diameter or the combined infill maximum height; with sleipnir's variable layers, up to 0.75 of the nozzle.

settings.label: Combined infill maximum height
settings.help: The tallest combined sparse infill layer, in mm or as a percent of the nozzle diameter. 100 % lets the infill reach the nozzle diameter.

settings.label: Interface shells
settings.help: On parts printed in more than one filament, gives each filament region its own solid top and bottom shells where it meets another filament. Off lets the infill run across the border.

settings.label: Solid infill angle template
settings.help: Angles for the top, bottom and internal solid infill lines, layer by layer, in degrees, such as 0,90. Bridges keep their own angle. Leave empty to use the solid infill direction.

effect.increase: Denser infill adds strength, filament and time
effect.decrease: Sparser infill saves filament and time but weakens the part

settings.label: Sparse infill angle template
settings.help: Angles for the sparse infill lines, layer by layer, in degrees. 0,90 alternates two directions and 0,60,120 cycles three. +5 turns the lines 5 degrees more every layer, +5#5 every five layers. Leave empty to use the infill direction.

settings.label: Mirror infill across the Y axis
Top and bottom infill to wall overlap
settings.help: How far the solid infill on the first and the topmost layer reaches into the walls, in percent of the gap between them. More overlap closes pinholes along the wall; too much makes the edge bulge. 25 to 30 % suits most prints.

effect.increase: Thicker top skin closes sparse infill gaps and adds time
effect.decrease: Thinner top skin can show infill pattern through the top

settings.label: Top surface density
settings.help: How densely the top surface is filled, in percent. 100 % gives a solid, smooth top; lower values space the lines out and save filament, and 0 leaves the top open.

effect.increase: More walls make the part stronger and add print time
effect.decrease: Fewer walls save time and filament but weaken the part

effect.increase: Supports are added under overhangs
effect.decrease: Overhangs print without support

settings.label: Support base pattern
settings.help: The pattern inside the support. Lightning grows thin branches that hold up only what needs it, inside slim, strong and hybrid tree supports; other supports print it as rectilinear. Hollow prints tree branches as walls only.

effect.increase: Support is added for more gentle overhangs
effect.decrease: Support is limited to steeper overhangs

settings.label: Vertical gap between support and part

effect.increase: Support separates more easily and leaves a rougher underside
effect.decrease: Support bonds tighter and leaves a smoother underside

settings.label: Tree support infill
settings.help: Fills large hollow areas inside tree supports with infill.

settings.label: Close additional fan first x layers
Fan off for the first layers

effect.increase: The fan stays off longer, which helps adhesion
effect.decrease: The fan starts sooner, which cools the first layers

effect.increase: More part cooling improves small features and bridges
effect.decrease: Less part cooling improves layer bonding

effect.increase: More part cooling improves overhangs and bridges and can weaken layer bonding
effect.decrease: Less part cooling improves layer bonding

settings.label: Layer where the fan reaches full speed
settings.help: The layer where the part cooling fan reaches full speed. From the first layer with the fan on, the fan and the overhang fan climb evenly up to this layer. 0 turns the climb off.

effect.increase: More fan on overhangs improves them
effect.decrease: Less fan on overhangs can curl them

settings.label: Overhang fan threshold
settings.help: How much a wall must overhang before the overhang fan speed applies. Bridges and overhang walls always get it; at 0% every outer wall does.

settings.label: Avoid stopping the fan between layers
Slow printing on short layers to cool them

effect.increase: Small layers slow down more to cool
effect.decrease: Small layers slow down less

settings.label: Slowest speed when cooling a layer

effect.increase: More flow fills gaps and can over-extrude
effect.decrease: Less flow prevents blobs and can under-extrude

effect.increase: A higher limit allows faster printing while the hotend keeps up
effect.decrease: A lower limit slows fast features to protect extrusion

effect.increase: Higher pressure advance sharpens corners and can gap them if too high
effect.decrease: Lower pressure advance rounds and bulges corners

settings.label: G-code on feature change
settings.help: G-code for this filament, written each time the print moves to another feature, after the printer's own. It can read extrusion_role, last_extrusion_role, layer_num and layer_z.

Filament tower interface pre extrusion dist
Filament tower interface pre extrusion length

settings.help: Overrides the printer's long retractions when cut for this filament. Empty uses the printer's value.

settings.help: Overrides the printer's retract before wipe for this filament. Empty uses the printer's value.

settings.help: Overrides the printer's retract at each layer change for this filament. Empty uses the printer's value.

settings.label: Filament retraction speed

settings.label: Filament wipe

settings.help: Overrides the printer's wipe distance for this filament. Empty uses the printer's value.

settings.help: Overrides the printer's z hop type for this filament. Empty uses the printer's value.

effect.increase: A warmer chamber reduces warping on ABS and similar materials
effect.decrease: A cooler chamber suits PLA

settings.label: Bed temperature on the Cool Plate

effect.increase: A hotter cool plate improves adhesion
effect.decrease: A cooler cool plate lowers adhesion

settings.label: Bed temperature on the Engineering Plate

effect.increase: A hotter engineering plate improves adhesion and limits warping
effect.decrease: A cooler engineering plate raises warping risk

settings.label: Bed temperature on the High Temp plate or smooth PEI

effect.increase: A hotter bed improves adhesion and can warp the first layers upward if too hot
effect.decrease: A cooler bed lowers adhesion

effect.increase: A hotter nozzle flows more freely and bonds layers better, with more stringing
effect.decrease: A cooler nozzle strings less and can under-extrude

settings.label: Hotend temperature for the first layer
Bed temperature on the SuperTack plate
Bed temperature on the Textured Cool Plate
Textured cool plate temp initial layer

effect.increase: A hotter textured plate improves adhesion
effect.decrease: A cooler textured plate lowers adhesion

settings.label: G-code on feature change
settings.help: G-code written each time the print moves to another feature, such as outer wall, sparse infill or support. It can read extrusion_role, last_extrusion_role, layer_num and layer_z.

settings.label: Tool start G-code
settings.help: G-code written right after the printer selects a tool, at the start and at every tool change. current_extruder is the tool just selected.

settings.label: File start gcode
settings.help: G-code at the very top of the file, before the header. Use it for lines a printer or host reads first.

settings.label: Machine end gcode
settings.default:
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
G28 X0  ; home X axis
M84     ; disable motors

settings.label: Machine start gcode
settings.default:
G28 ; home all axes
G1 Z5 F5000 ; lift nozzle

settings.label: Printing by object gcode
settings.help: G-code run before each object after the first when printing by object, over the next object before the nozzle comes down. {current_object_idx} is the object's place in the plate list.

settings.label: Time lapse gcode
settings.help: G-code for a timelapse frame on every layer. Most printers run it right after the layer change. Bambu Lab printers run it at the start of the layer, or on bed slingers once the walls of the first part with infill are done, and wrap it in the layer's object mask so skipped objects skip it too.

settings.label: Wrapping detection gcode
settings.help: G-code for the printer's filament wrapping check, run on every layer before its first filament when wrapping detection is on.

settings.label: Bed temperature formula
settings.help: Which filament sets the bed temperature when a plate prints several: the first one, or the highest bed temperature among the filaments the layer prints.

settings.label: Tool change position
settings.help: Where the head goes before and after each extruder's tool change, in printer coordinates. UltiMaker printers switch print cores there.

settings.label: Print core
settings.help: The print core each extruder holds, such as AA 0.4 or BB 0.4. UltiMaker printers check it against the core they hold before they start.

settings.label: Bed areas excluded for parallel heads

settings.label: Lift at a tool change
settings.help: How far the nozzle lifts before a tool change and stays lifted until it reaches the next print move.
